fichas.title: Man as Measure and Purpose
fichas.summary: Introductory discussion of human beings as the proper scale for designing buildings, rooms, furniture, and objects. It emphasizes understanding bodily dimensions, postures, movement, spatial needs, and emotional responses to rooms, while using human-scale observation and systematic data to support independent design decisions.
uses: Assess human-scale dimensions for buildings, rooms, furniture, and objects
Accommodate reaching, working, movement, tasks, and relaxation
Develop a clear visual understanding of spatial scale
Inform architectural design through systematically gathered data and standards
